title: Ernie Jr.'s age, and Rene Hall's guidance after In The Mood
summary: Fields notes Junior is about forty-three and that Rene discouraged vocals on the post-hit records.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: How old is Ernie Fields Jr. now?
Junior is forty--he's in his forties--he's about forty-three.
I thought he was much younger than that.
I didn't know, I thought he was--well, he was when he came to California.
Yeah, yeah, then, but that was several years ago.
Yeah, when I was still there.

Incidentally, right after this In The Mood, Rene discouraged me from using anything vocal there. It was still me, but what we did--I don't have any of that with me, but I'm going to send you a tape to send to Ron on (inaudible) and Ernie Fields Jr., because it would still mean that I produced that and I want you to see that. That was under his direction.
Is Ron writing about my life as a booker and this and that, because I did that
